screen_a_washed_out_alt.universe: Bitunix USDT-M futures, exclude BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT
filters: mark at least 80% below the 180-day high
enough 24h quote volume to fill a small order
SL = lowest daily low of ~120 days, placed about 6% above that low, and 20-45% under the mark
TP = 180-365 day high rounded down to one significant figure, and at least 5x the mark
text leverage 7x; desk size uses its own risk tiers

price not already more than 8x the listing-day low
